newsitem.title: USA: WinStar sees EBITDA losses peaking late '97.
newsitem.headline: WinStar sees EBITDA losses peaking late '97.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Tuesday it expects its quarterly EBITDA losses to peak by the end of 1997 and decline in 1998, and it now foresees lower capital expenditures over the next three years than originally expected.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment further.
WinStar said in a press statement that the rate of growth in its quarterly EBITDA losses is expected to slow after the second quarter.
WinStar said it expects its capital expenditures to be lower than originally expected.

The company had planned to spend $500 million in the three-year period 1997-99. It now expects to spend no more than $450 million in that period, due mainly to lower expenditures on customer premise equipment than in the original budget.
